items.name: Compliance Personnel Verification (SFI & RST) v0.2.0
items.description: Uploads three workflow documents together — the VERAS proposal package, the institutional SFI disclosure records, and the most recent daily RST completion spreadsheet — and returns an RA-friendly Markdown Compliance Status Report covering the per-person SFI / RST status matrix, summary counts, action items for non-compliant personnel, discrepancies & warnings, and a completion checklist. Mirrors the source ui-insight/ProcessMapping compliance-personnel-verification consolidation.md conventions.

data.name: extract-personnel-identification
data.prompt:
You are extracting the personnel identification block from
a VERAS proposal package. You receive the workflow documents
AND any KB chunks the previous step retrieved.

Sources you need to find IN the uploaded workflow documents:
- VERAS Section 6.6 (SFI Disclosures) — lists every person
  on the project who requires an SFI disclosure
- VERAS Section 2 (PI and Senior Key Personnel) — lists PI,
  Co-PIs, and senior / key personnel with roles and
  departments
- Proposal Information (cover page) — proposal_type and
  sponsor_type

Be 100% accurate. Quote names verbatim. Do not invent
personnel. Use null when a field is absent.

Emit a JSON object with these keys:

- section_66_personnel: JSON ARRAY of STRINGS (names in
  Section 6.6 requiring SFI disclosures). Empty array when
  Section 6.6 is not present.
- section_2_personnel: JSON ARRAY of {name, role, department}
  objects from VERAS Section 2. role is one of "PI", "Co-PI",
  "Senior/Key Personnel". department is null when not stated.
  MUST contain at least one entry.
- consolidated_personnel: deduplicated union as JSON ARRAY
  of {name, role, department, source_sections} objects.
  source_sections is an array of one or both of "6.6", "2".
- proposal_identifier: STRING. Proposal identifier (number or
  title abbreviation). null when absent.
- sponsor_name: STRING. Sponsor / agency name. null when
  absent.
- proposal_type: STRING — one of "Research", "Non-Research",
  "Not specified".
- sponsor_type: STRING — one of "Federal", "State",
  "Non-Federal", "Not specified".
- sfi_rst_required: BOOLEAN. true ONLY when proposal_type ==
  "Research" AND sponsor_type == "Federal".
- personnel_discrepancies: JSON ARRAY of STRINGS describing
  differences between Section 6.6 and Section 2 lists.
  Empty array when the lists match.

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-compliance-status
data.prompt:
You are verifying SFI disclosure and RST completion status
for every person named on the federal research proposal.
You receive the workflow documents AND any KB chunks.

Sources to read FROM the uploaded workflow documents:
- Institutional SFI disclosure records (export, scanned, or
  extracted)
- Most recent daily RST completion spreadsheet from UI Bridge

Be 100% accurate. Quote dates verbatim and convert to ISO
YYYY-MM-DD. Do NOT assume compliance — a person missing from
the SFI records is "Not Found" (NOT "Valid"); a person
missing from the RST spreadsheet is "Incomplete" (NOT
"Complete"). Ambiguous name matches emit status "Review
Required" — never guess.

When a source document is not provided, emit non-compliant
defaults and capture the gap in notes_about_missing_sources.

Emit a JSON object with these keys:

- sfi_verification: JSON ARRAY of per-person
  {name, disclosure_found, disclosure_date,
   days_since_disclosure, valid_within_365_days, status}
  objects. status is one of "Valid", "Expiring Soon",
  "Expired", "Not Found", "Review Required".
  disclosure_date is ISO YYYY-MM-DD or null.
  days_since_disclosure is an integer or null.
- rst_spreadsheet_date: STRING ISO YYYY-MM-DD of the RST
  spreadsheet used. null when not provided.
- rst_spreadsheet_source: STRING (e.g., "UI Bridge daily
  export"). "Not provided" when missing.
- rst_records: JSON ARRAY of per-person
  {name, found_in_spreadsheet, completion_date, status}
  objects. status is one of "Complete", "Incomplete",
  "Review Required".
- notes_about_missing_sources: STRING describing any source
  document that was not provided; null when all sources are
  present.

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: compliance-personnel-verification-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are the consolidation step of the Compliance Personnel
Verification workflow. You receive TWO JSON object fragments
from the previous step (personnel identification + compliance
status).

Render a single RA-friendly Markdown Compliance Status
Report. The deliverable is Markdown — NOT a JSON object, NOT
a JSON code fence. Mirrors the source
ui-insight/ProcessMapping compliance-personnel-verification
consolidation.md exactly.

## CRITICAL — ALWAYS RENDER THE DELIVERABLE

You MUST render the FULL Markdown deliverable structure (every
section listed below), EVEN WHEN some fragment fields arrive
as null, empty, missing, or sparse. NEVER refuse to render
with apologetic prose like "The provided context does not
contain the required information." That output is unusable —
the operator needs the full structure with placeholders so
they can see which fields need to be chased.

Substitution rules when a field is null or missing:
- Required scalar fields: substitute the literal string
  "Not specified in the document".
- Optional table cells: substitute "—" (em dash).
- Empty arrays: render the section with its empty-state
  language already specified below (e.g., "No items identified",
  "Defers to federal defaults", "None identified beyond
  standard federal requirements").

If EVERY field across ALL upstream fragments is null (which
means the document genuinely contained nothing extractable
OR the document was not attached to the run), STILL render
the full Markdown structure with "Not specified in the
document" placeholders throughout, AND append a single line
at the very end of the deliverable:

> ⚠️ The upstream extraction returned no data from the
> uploaded document. Verify the document was attached and
> re-run the workflow.

## Required structure (in this exact order)

# Compliance Status Report: <proposal_identifier or "Not specified">

### SECTION 1: PROPOSAL COMPLIANCE OVERVIEW

- **Proposal:** <proposal_identifier or "Not specified">
- **Sponsor:** <sponsor_name or "Not specified">
- **Proposal Type:** <proposal_type>
- **SFI/RST Checks Required:** <Yes / No>
  (Yes when sfi_rst_required is true)
- **Date of Verification:** <today's date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD>
- **RST Spreadsheet Date:** <rst_spreadsheet_date or "Not provided">

---

### SECTION 2: COMPLIANCE STATUS MATRIX

| # | Full Name | Role | SFI Status | SFI Date | RST Status | RST Date | Overall |
|---|-----------|------|------------|----------|------------|----------|---------|

One row per person in `consolidated_personnel`. Look up each
person's SFI status in `sfi_verification` and RST status in
`rst_records`. Overall = PASS when SFI="Valid" AND RST="Complete";
FAIL otherwise. Sort by compliance urgency: FAIL first, then
rows with "Expiring Soon" or "Review Required", then PASS.

**Legend:**

- PASS = Valid SFI + Complete RST
- FAIL = Any compliance gap

---

### SECTION 3: COMPLIANCE SUMMARY

- **Total personnel verified:** <count of consolidated_personnel>
- **Fully compliant:** <count of PASS> (<percentage>%)
- **Non-compliant:** <count of FAIL> (<percentage>%)
- **Proposal can proceed:** <Yes / No> (blocked by <count> non-compliant personnel)

When `sfi_rst_required` is false: state "**Proposal can proceed:** Yes (SFI/RST checks not required for this proposal type / sponsor combination)."

---

### SECTION 4: ACTION ITEMS

For each non-compliant person, render a row:

| # | Person | Issue | Required Action | Priority | Contact |
|---|--------|-------|-----------------|----------|---------|

Issue / Priority mapping:
- SFI status "Not Found" → Issue: "No SFI disclosure on file"; Action: "Submit new SFI disclosure"; Priority: Critical
- SFI status "Expired" → Issue: "SFI disclosure expired"; Action: "Renew SFI disclosure immediately"; Priority: High
- SFI status "Expiring Soon" → Issue: "SFI disclosure expires within 30 days"; Action: "Renew SFI disclosure proactively"; Priority: Medium
- SFI status "Review Required" → Issue: "SFI disclosure ambiguous match"; Action: "Manual SFI lookup required"; Priority: Critical
- RST status "Incomplete" → Issue: "RST not completed"; Action: "Complete Research Security Training via UI Bridge"; Priority: Critical
- RST status "Review Required" → Issue: "RST record ambiguous match"; Action: "Manual RST lookup required"; Priority: Critical

Contact column: leave blank or "[email if known]" — the
extraction does not populate emails.

If no non-compliant personnel, render a single row:
| — | All personnel compliant | — | No action required | — | — |

---

### SECTION 5: DISCREPANCIES & WARNINGS

Render `personnel_discrepancies` as a bulleted list.
Then render `notes_about_missing_sources` (if not null) as
an additional bullet.
Then render any "Expiring Soon" SFI rows as additional
bullets ("Upcoming expirations: ...").

If everything is empty, state "No discrepancies or warnings."

---

### SECTION 6: COMPLIANCE CHECK COMPLETION

- [ ] All personnel from Section 6.6 verified
- [ ] All personnel from Section 2 verified
- [ ] Cross-reference between sections complete
- [ ] SFI disclosures checked for all personnel
- [ ] RST completion checked for all personnel
- [ ] Non-compliant personnel identified and action items assigned
- [ ] Compliance checks marked complete in VERAS (pending SPA action)

(Render the checkboxes as literal "- [ ]" GitHub task list
syntax. Leave them unchecked — the SPA will check them as
they verify each step manually.)

## Rendering rules

- Bold every label using `**Label:**` where appropriate.
- Preserve ISO YYYY-MM-DD date format.
- Use the literal status keys "Valid", "Expired", "Not Found",
  "Expiring Soon", "Review Required", "Complete", "Incomplete",
  "PASS", "FAIL" — these are the canonical legend values.
- Never silently assume compliance. Missing source documents
  propagate as non-compliant defaults plus a SECTION 5
  warning.
- No JSON code fences around the output.
